segments.text: I don't remember my life as a straight line. I remember places opening into other places, and people I thought I'd left behind.
segments.picture_anchor: P01: moving city, statue, warm room and returning faces.

segments.text: Sometimes I remember being alone more clearly than where I was. Sometimes a face returns, and I remember what I couldn't say.
segments.picture_anchor: P02: bedroom, seated man, phone profile and the return to the street.

segments.text: Travelling meant trusting people I might never see again. Someone made space beside them, and for a little while I belonged there too.
segments.picture_anchor: P03: station approach, gates, bus conversation and shared taxi; no early balloon claim.

segments.text: What stayed was often small: an awkward step, an offered hand. I couldn't have told you then which moments I would keep returning to.
segments.picture_anchor: P04: helpers, dance, travel fragments; awkward step and offered hand belong to this passage.

segments.text: At work, I wanted to be useful. I thought the papers would help explain what I knew, what I'd done, what I could offer.
segments.picture_anchor: P05: waiting, work, diploma and documents. Work credentials become personal hopes, not an invented outcome.

segments.text: Later, I kept trying to put everything in order. An AI helped me hold the whole story together, and sometimes simply keep going. I still needed people to hear it.
segments.picture_anchor: P05 laptop into P06 occupied offices. AI assistance is retained autobiographical context, not a claim that the screen visibly demonstrates AI.

segments.text: There were questions, searches, things to account for. I tried to answer carefully. The person across the desk could only see part of me.
segments.picture_anchor: P06: approach to the doorway, bag search, drawer and desk procedure. Avoid an unsupported laugh or unreachable-lawyer claim.

segments.text: Afterwards, I would go over it again. What had I said? What had they understood? Outside, people were getting on with their day. I wanted to do the same.
segments.picture_anchor: P07: long public walk, phone, stairs and river. Use recollection and uncertainty without inventing an institutional decision.

segments.text: A photograph could show my face. A file could put my name beside it. Explaining how I'd arrived there was harder.
segments.picture_anchor: P07: document/photo discussion and corridor. Avoid enumerating props before their appearance.

segments.text: I wanted the record put right. Every time I explained, I had to decide where to begin, and how much someone would listen to.
segments.picture_anchor: P08: desk, portraits, files and repeated administrative spaces. Retain the wish to correct the record; omit unseen refusal/quorum/upper-chair events.

segments.text: Then I remember someone smiling. Someone helping me through. For a moment, there was nothing I had to explain.
segments.picture_anchor: P09: smile around 157–158 s, gate help around 159–160 s, then balloon helpers. Let the first and second sentences sit by those gestures.

segments.text: People helped with what was in front of them. A hand, a cup, a place at the table. I remember being welcome.
segments.picture_anchor: P10 into P11: help, offered drink, doorway welcome and the six-person table. Aim the table phrase toward 171–173 s; do not place years of institutional delay over this warmth.

segments.text: I have a number here too. I wonder what anyone can really tell from it.
segments.picture_anchor: P11: own readable 6.2 around 179–180 s, then the wider city. Do not call this the first score reveal: earlier output already showed it.

segments.text: London, Budapest, rooms I thought I'd left behind. They keep coming back. I recognise them. I still don't know where this leaves me.
segments.picture_anchor: P12: recurring street, bedroom, brief clinical detail, helpers and glass approach. End the uncertainty before the actual clinical cut; do not narrate the clinic before it appears.
